title: Native pins: tests for sync, versions, backup and photos
why: Seven ManifestKit rules have no test that pins them, so a Swift change can break sync or restore unseen.
note: No simulator: swift test --package-path native/ManifestKit proves each. Owns SyncClient, SyncSocket, Versions, Backup, Photo* and their tests, never LedgerStore, Packages, Tally or the card rules. Order: native-pull-generation-unpinned, native-milestone-needed-unpinned, native-version-names-unpinned, native-removal-rule-is-swift, native-restore-keeps-old-times, native-photo-ids-kept-uncalled, native-sync-glue-unpinned. One branch per debt off origin/main; test-author red first, builder, one reviewer.
ask: Lane pins started 2026-11-06 by the coordinator.
